title: Challenges page
text: Side games for next season: survivor, king of the hill, weekly high score and more. Nothing is running yet. Have a look and say which ones you would play.

title: Champions table
text: Every title game with the runner-up, third place and the final score, plus a tag when the finalist with the worse record won it.

title: Power rankings get a score
text: Each team now shows a 0 to 100 power score next to its bar. 50 is a league-average team. The ranking itself has not changed.

title: One Standings page
text: Power rankings, all-play, luck and lineup efficiency now sit on the Standings page as sections, with a jump-to row at the top. Three menu items are gone; nothing was removed.

title: Head-to-head grid on Rivalries
text: Every manager's record against every other manager on one grid. Green means the row leads the series, red means it trails. Tap a square for the full rivalry.

title: Jump to a section on long pages
text: Pages with four or more sections now start with a row of links, so you can go straight to the part you want.

title: Newsletters on the home page
text: The three latest issues sit right under this box, and each issue now ends with what is new on the site.

title: Playoff Picture
text: The seeds if the season ended today, how far every team is from the last spot, and which games left have a playoff place riding on them.

title: Rivalry pages show what kind of game each meeting was
text: Every meeting is tagged regular season, playoff or consolation, and the series record is split the same way. All of them still count.

title: Playoff odds that know your roster
text: Starting with the week 10 results, the odds and the weekly win chances read each team's current roster, injuries, byes and NFL matchups, not only what the team has scored so far.

title: This box
text: Additions and fixes to the site get listed here as they happen.

title: Trade matrix
text: A grid of how many trades every pair of managers has made. Tap a number to see those trades.

title: If the season ended today
text: Each weekly newsletter now shows the playoff field, the byes and the first-round games as the standings sit.

title: The what-if tracker
text: Each weekly newsletter tracks where the league would stand without kickers and with a league median game.
